summary: SSR Mining Inc. filed a Form 8-K to report entry into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated July 31, 2026. The new agreement provides a $600.0 million senior secured revolving credit facility, up from $400.0 million under the prior 2023 facility. It matures on July 31, 2030, with extension provisions. Borrowings may be in USD or CAD with variable interest rates based on several benchmarks plus margins depending on net leverage ratio. The facility is secured by substantially all personal property of the company and material subsidiaries. Amendments also increased investment baskets to $400 million and capital lease/purchase money lien limits to $200 million, and added financial covenants including an interest coverage ratio of 3.00x and net leverage ratio requirements. This is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation.
